dominant_strengths: Clear dev-mode storytelling: spec callouts, component tags, and version history surround a real artifact, demonstrating the feature in context
Tasteful muted sage canvas paired with serif 'Library' mock gives the marketing shot a curated, editorial craft feel
Multiplayer cursors and inspector panel communicate collaboration and handoff value without needing copy
dominant_weaknesses: Callout labels compete for attention—Text Style, Font, Fill, Component all share similar dark pills, creating visual noise around the phone
Right-side dev panel is cropped and dense, weakening hierarchy between hero artifact and supporting inspector evidence
Color palette mixes sage green, purple selection, blue cursor, and red avatar tag without a unifying accent system
fix_priorities: Differentiate callout types via weight/opacity hierarchy so spec pills recede and the phone artifact dominates
Reframe or fully reveal the right inspector panel to anchor the dev-mode narrative rather than tease it
Constrain accent colors to one collaboration hue plus one selection hue for palette coherence
rationale.norman_balance: Behavioral clarity (showing exactly what dev mode does) leads, with moderate visceral polish and reflective trust from version history, but the composition leans utilitarian over emotive.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes—it directly visualizes Figma Dev Mode handoff with specs, components, and version trail, fitting a feature-marketing scroll module.
